{{Quote|Prepare to die, Imperial dog. You'll never escape this bunker alive.|[[First Lieutenant/Legends|First Lieutenant]] [[Verls Tarrk|Tarrk]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:IM" />}}
A '''Rebel bunker''' was built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], this small base was used by a troop of [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]] led by [[First Lieutenant/Legends|First Lieutenant]] [[Verls Tarrk]].<ref name="SWG:IM" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] under orders of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Veers]] attacked the bunker and killed First Lieutenant Tarrk.<ref name="SWG:IM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel bunker was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The bunker was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Imperial Theme Park|Imperial Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:IM" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes 6.12: September 13 2007|Chapter 6.12]]" update, on [[September 13]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67417&month=092007|text=Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
